title: Manager prep - Q1 2026 self review and goals
content:
Purpose: notes to prepare for 1:1 with manager (Mar 05), self-review submission, and calibration. Draft - not polished.

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Major wins: rolled out onboarding overhaul (reduced time-to-product from 14d to 9d), led hiring bar improvements for IC4+ roles, launched new manager enablement workshop (pilot to 30 managers).
- Metrics to highlight: new hire ramp metric (onboard -> first PR prod) improved 35% vs Q4; offer-accept rate improved from 72% -> 84% for mid-SWE roles after updated interview rubric; time-to-fill (ECR) down 10 days for priority roles.
- Stretch areas: build a systematic career ladder for people-ops (competency matrix), get better at cross-functional influence for infra/eng changes, and own hiring efficiency dashboard (end-to-end funnel).

Accomplishments (examples to cite in review):
1) Onboarding overhaul (Jan 2026):
   - Led cross-functional workstream (Eng, Infra, DX) to remove manual steps and automate account provisioning (JIRA: PPL-318, PRs linked in Confluence).
   - Outcome: median time to first production-pr dropped from 14d -> 9d in pilot cohort (n=24).
   - Evidence: onboarding-survey-2026-Q1 (Confluence) + sample success stories.

2) Manager enablement pilot (Feb 2026):
   - Designed curriculum + materials; ran 3 sessions for 30 managers; post-survey NPS 72.
   - Immediate action: added manager checklist to Console onboarding flow.

3) Hiring & interview process improvements:
   - Worked with Eng-recruiting to tighten interview rubrics for IC4+; updated scorecards and interviewer calibration guide (PPL-342).
   - Impact: offer-accept rate +12ppt for targeted hiring bands.

Challenges / open items to discuss:
- Banding/compensation edge cases: several IC4 hires in EMEA need localized comp exceptions - need decision sooner than EOM.
- Analytics gaps: hiring funnel visibility stops at offer; no consistent time-series for candidate drop-offs by stage - propose a 6-week analytics spike (sends ask to product-analytics).
- Manager bandwidth: sustaining manager enablement at scale will require a 0.5 FTE or rotation plan - want manager input on prioritization.

Career goals (12-18 months):
- Short term (6 months): be recognized as owner of hiring quality & onboarding for infra/serving-runtime; establish hiring funnel dashboards; run quarterly manager enablement at scale.
- Mid term (12 months): create a documented competency/career ladder for People Ops roles (IC2 -> IC5), paired with clear promotion criteria.
- Growth areas I want coaching on: stakeholder influence with Product/Infra execs, setting measurable outcomes for org-level programs, and compensation calibration best practices.

Promotion readiness checklist (self-assessment):
- Impact: Delivered measurable org-level improvements (see metrics above) - yes.
- Scope: Cross-functional leadership across Eng, Infra, DX - yes, piloted and scaled.
- Level of autonomy: Owns planning and execution for onboarding & hiring improvements - yes.
- Coaching/mentoring: Regularly mentor 2 junior people-ops teammates; ran onboarding training for new hires.
- Recommendation: I feel ready to move to Senior People Ops (IC4) based on impact and scope, pending feedback on stakeholder influence.

Comp/raise ask (draft to discuss):
- Benchmark: Similar roles at startups at this stage are around $X base + target 15% bonus (I have comp data from recruiter conversation, will share in doc).
- Ask: Consider promotion to IC4 with adjusted comp band (range suggestion included in Confluence doc).

Questions for manager (to bring up in 1:1):
- What additional evidence would you like to see for promotion readiness? Specific examples I should collect?
- Are you aligned on prioritizing the hiring funnel analytics spike? Will you sponsor the ask to Product Analytics?
- For EMEA comp exceptions: is there flexibility in the budget cycle or do we need to make role-level tradeoffs?
- Manager enablement: can we allocate 0.5 FTE or rotate responsibilities across team to sustain the program?

Notes / talking points (script for 1:1):
- Start with quick wins and metrics (onboarding, offer accept).
- Highlight cross-functional ownership and scalability of solutions.
- State readiness for step-up and request explicit feedback and next steps for promotion packet.
- Ask for clarity on budget timelines / comp exceptions.

To-do before 1:1 (by Mar 04):
- Pull raw onboarding cohort data and attach sample stories (Maria to help).
- Upload manager enablement materials to Confluence + anonymized survey results.
- Draft promotion packet outline (1-pager + 3-5 evidence items).
- Prepare 2-3 asks with timelines (analytics spike, comp exception, FTE allocation).

References / evidence links (placeholders):
- Confluence: onboarding-overhaul-2026 (detailed notes + charts).
- JIRA: PPL-318 (onboarding automation), PPL-342 (interview calibration).
- Slack threads: #people-ops-announce (pilot feedback).

Notes to self: keep this conversational. Open to manager feedback and iterative changes. Will finalize self-review submission by Mar 06 and attach links.

End of draft.
